packageRules.description: Keep routine dependency updates from every manager in one PR
Keep this at least as long as the min-release-age the dev-tools installer writes to ~/.npmrc, which rejects anything younger outright.

uv only resolves PyPI artifacts older than the exclude-newer window in dot_config/uv/uv.toml, so a pin newer than that window cannot be installed at all. Keep this value at least as long as that window.

Stable Cargo has no release-age filter, so this rule is the only window for mbx, which wraps local Cargo builds. Cargo versioning reads the bare pin as a caret range that already covers every compatible release, so it would never propose one.
TypeScript 7 ships no lib/tsserver.js, which typescript-language-server launches.
